title: Habit app UI reel — one surface morphs from app icon to button, form, tab bar, stats, widget, book card and a check

source.author: @thednyx
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the Habitify UI reel by dnyxstudios; structure and pacing follow it. The app icon, book cover and end card are fictional placeholders; the original's real book and studio name are not used.

scenes: the app icon spins in and settles, a gloss sweeps across it
a tap turns it into a round plus button, then into a tilted 'Create Good Habit' pill
the pill opens into a form card; the title and rows type themselves in
the card flattens into a tab bar that slides under the cursor: Home, Friends, Progress
a seven-day stats card fills its squares, then folds into a widget with a progress ring
the widget turns into an orange book card, which pops into a check mark
end card with a glowing name
notes: Every state is one shape: S holds each state's size, corner radius (-1 = fully round) and colour, M holds the morph timings, and each state's contents cross-fade and squash with the shape. The tab bar's slide positions (TABC) and the cursor path (CK) are tuned to the four tab labels; retime them together if the labels change length a lot. The filled squares in the stats card come from FILL (days done per habit).
